subject: shinydashboard::tabItems does not accept tagList of tabItem's

messages.author: d36f7ab053ca105e
messages.subject: shinydashboard::tabItems does not accept tagList of tabItem's
parts:
Hi all

I am getting the following error when I try to pass a tagList of tabItem 's to shinydashboard::tagItems.  

Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : Expected an object with class 'shiny.tag'.

Any ideas?

Many thanks
Emmanuel

messages.author: d36f7ab053ca105e
messages.subject: Re: shinydashboard::tabItems does not accept tagList of tabItem's
parts:
Minimal example of this issue is:

shinydashboard::tabItems(
     shiny::tagList(
             shinydashboard::tabItem(tabName = 'abc')
     )
)

messages.author: d36f7ab053ca105e
messages.subject: Re: shinydashboard::tabItems does not accept tagList of tabItem's
parts:
It turned out to be quite simple solution. 
Instead of  tabItems( taglist_of_tabitem ) use tags$div( taglist_of_tabitem , class = "tab-content" )
Emmanuel
